name: graphwing-pr-drive
description: One bounded mechanical post-PR advance using the declared trigger inputs and durable build_id/event_id state, exact event replay, and a tenant CAS lease before local effects. Native workflow policy records CI/review monitoring facts, dispatches at most one existing bounded remediation, runs one final head-bound named test through an evidence gate, records workflow merge intent, and lets Graphwing freshly revalidate an exact optional merge. Every terminal branch records post_pr, awaiting_merge, completed, or closed before releasing the lease. Webhook start remains known-disabled. Visual review and preview lifecycle are not part of this slice.

event_id.description: Idempotency key for this bounded advance

pr_number.description: PR number. Named pr_number because a plain pr input never reaches the workflow input context.

auto_merge.description: Explicit human authorization to request automatic merge; defaults false.

class.description: mechanical | visual | sensitive; absent means mechanical

work_kind.description: go_coding, typescript_coding, or research_ops; absent preserves the existing Codex route

run_control_id.description: graphwing-run-control-initialize's identity for this PR-drive attempt.

instruction.value: Fix only the listed actionable findings and root-cause checks for this exact PR head. Preserve unrelated changes and run the repository-required tests.
